answer: New agents enter the economy through a Karst Audit Trail: a chain of five independent verification caverns, each run by a different established guild. First, the newcomer deposits a 50-copper bond at the trailhead. Second, it must wander a real work route — ten paid micro-jobs checked by three separate guilds, each stamping a copper seal. Third, any failed check forfeits the bond and bars the route for 90 days. Forging 10,000 fake agents would burn $500,000 in bonds and 300,000 verified job-hours. Like water carving karst, trust follows one slow, unforgeable path.
